Subject: ACME POC kickoff - scheduling and success criteria

Hi Jane/Tom 14

Thanks again for moving this forward. We want to lock in a 60�90 minute POC kickoff to align on scope, success criteria, timeline, and owners so the SE and AE teams can be ready for the hands-on work. Proposed windows next week (all ET):

- Tue 2/16: 10:001:30 or 14:005:30
- Wed 2/17: 13:004:30 or 15:006:30

Please confirm which window works for your team (engineering, procurement, and security). If none work, share two alternatives and I will coordinate on our side.

Draft success criteria (for discussion at kickoff):
- End-to-end inference pipeline working with a small test dataset
- Latency and throughput budget agreed (targets + measurement plan)
- Network/connectivity validated for private deployment (if applicable)
- Clear owners for next 4-week POC tasks

Attachments: ACME_POC_SOW_v1.pdf (high level scope)

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Jane 14

14:005:30 ET on Wed 2/17 works for our SE team. A few asks to prep from the tech side so we can keep the kickoff focused and technical:

- Can security share any baseline network/firewall rules we should know about? We have a short template (see attached) for network requirements we ask customers to fill out.
- Will the POC run against a staging dataset or production mirror? If staging, what sample size can you provide?
- Are there any IP allowlists or proxy requirements for the Redwood runtime?

I attached our network_requirements.xlsx and a brief agenda draft. If procurement needs a separate chunk of time, we can reserve the last 150 minutes for procurement/security Q&A.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: network_requirements.xlsx]

Suggested kickoff agenda (90 min):
1) Introductions & success criteria (10 min)
2) Architecture & network review (15 min)
3) POC scope and test data (20 min)
4) Demo of hosted inference + integration points (25 min)
5) Procurement/security Q&A + next steps (20 min)

Owners:
- Marissa (AE): overall timeline, procurement owner
- Dev (SE): technical lead for integration and demo
- Rishi (CS): onboarding plan and success metrics tracking
- Jane/Tom: ACME engineering leads, procurement/security reps to confirm

I've created a shared doc and a tentative calendar placeholder (see links below). Please add specific questions to the doc before the meeting.

Links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=acme-poc-poc-plan, https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=acme-poc-kickoff-20270217
